snippet.title: Aniimo Tokyo Game Show Exclusive Trailer | Discover Even More Aniiimo! | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Welcome to Aniimo, a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world ARPG coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC in 2026.

At TGS, we took the opportunity to reveal even more of our Aniimo friends to the world - this was one of the top pieces of feedback following the first beta test earlier this year. Fans just can't get enough of the Aniimo, and want to know more about them, their environment, their relationships and behaviors. 
All footage is in-game, so this is the quality of experience you'll enjoy when playing (and we're still working to make it even better!) 
If you're not yet familiar with Aniimo - welcome to the journey! We hope you'll enjoy getting to know these incredible creatures. 
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/aniimo/9PK8PHLCQDF6
